title: Zombie Outbreak Day 2: The Rescue Boat (3/3)

characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI; one flip-flop left after Day 1
characters.Captain Reyes: coast guard skipper, orange jacket, cap, voice [man]
characters.Dale: survivor in a grey long-sleeve, hiding a bite on his arm
characters.Fisherman: old man in a green raincoat, voice [man]

scenes.narration: Two hundred yards from a beach full of infected. One man turning on deck. And the cabin door is opening.
The man with the sleeve lunged.
[tess] Kai! Kai grabbed the only thing he had. The tarp.
He threw it over the man's head, and pushed.
Over the rail. Into the sea.
And the infected man just stood there, underwater. He wouldn't swim.
Then the cabin door burst open.
Then Kai remembered a trick from the surf shop. Trousers float.
Tie the legs in a knot. Swing them over your head to fill them with air. Hold the waist underwater.
Seven pairs of trousers. Seven floats.
They floated beside the boat while the infected walked the deck above them. Not one would jump in.
At sunset, Tess flashed her phone at the horizon. Three flashes. Stop. Three flashes.
Kai climbed aboard. Shorts soaked. One flip-flop. But somehow, the shirt survived. Bone dry.
[tess] Where is this boat going? [man] The fuel dock. [man] If it's still there.
Would you have jumped? Tell me. Day three is tomorrow.
